requirements.text: RESEARCH-REQUESTS CHANNEL — docs/RESEARCH_REQUESTS.md exists (created with this capture) as the running owner-assisted research queue. The build loop MAY append research-shaped requests (plain-English question, why it matters, what it unlocks, citations sought) for the owner's external deep-research tooling, instead of or in advance of spending its own research cycles. NON-BLOCKING: the loop never waits on the channel; absent an answer it proceeds with its own official-source-researcher work as normal.
requirements.required_harness: document exists; loop appends requests with the template fields; no task blocks on an unanswered request
requirements.required_evidence: docs/RESEARCH_REQUESTS.md in repo; campaign packets reference it where used

requirements.text: RESULTS ARE LEADS, NEVER SOURCES OF RECORD — owner-supplied research results (external deep-research output) enter as DISCOVERY AIDS with citations. No rule, connector, snapshot, or fact may cite the research itself as provenance: every load-bearing claim is verified against the official source through the standard capture discipline (incl. the print/PDF-class completeness rule where applicable) before use; rule provenance cites the captured official text, with the research credited only as a discovery note. Interpretation-class conclusions still require the D-048/D-049 path (owner decision or qualified ruling), never research alone.
requirements.required_harness: no citation chain terminates at owner research; captures verified as usual

requirements.text: ROUTING — results return either through the companion session (which records them in docs/RESEARCH_REQUESTS.md with the owner's citations and relays to the build session) or by the owner pasting directly into the build session; either way the receiving session marks the request ANSWERED with the date and the follow-on verification target. Requests whose answer is interpretation (what a law MEANS) are routed to docs/ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md instead, per D-048-R004.
requirements.required_harness: request lifecycle visible in the doc (OPEN -> ANSWERED/ROUTED)

requirements.text: RELAY / ACKNOWLEDGMENT (return item) — the companion session relays this directive to the build session; the build session acknowledges and begins appending research requests where useful (starting with the wave-3 lanes). Discharged when acknowledged and the doc carries its first loop-appended or loop-consumed entry.
requirements.required_evidence: message in this capture's audit_log; document history

requirements.text: ACTIVE NOTIFICATION (amendment 1) — appending to docs/RESEARCH_REQUESTS.md is NEVER sufficient notice by itself. When new owner-addressed requests are appended, and while any remain OPEN: (a) the build session states them in owner-visible turn output at every owner-facing seam (wave summaries, session landings, handoff 'owner items') as one line per request; (b) on appending new requests, it sends a PushNotification (desktop; phone when Remote Control is connected) — batched into one message, one line, only for genuinely new asks; (c) the companion session surfaces new/open requests whenever the owner converses with it. The loop-monitoring quiet rule is narrowed accordingly: owner-addressed research requests are never silent. The non-blocking rule (R001) is unchanged — notify, then proceed without waiting.
requirements.required_harness: turn output + handoff carry open-request lines; PushNotification sent on new appends; companion relays in conversation
requirements.required_evidence: session transcripts/handoff content; notification tool results where recorded

requirements.text: IMMEDIATE UPDATE + COMPACT CLOSURE + PHONE ACCESS (amendment 2) — (a) The pushed branch's docs/RESEARCH_REQUESTS.md is the owner's phone-readable copy (GitHub file URL in the doc header): every queue change is committed AND pushed in the same working step, never left dirty-local or batched. (b) When the owner returns results, the receiving session marks the entry ANSWERED (date + named verification target) immediately. (c) When a request is SATISFIED (answer verified/consumed, everything checks out), its full entry is REMOVED from the active queue and collapsed to a one-line row in the file's Closed register (id - outcome - date - where the answer lives); full text stays in git history; the active file never accumulates satisfied requests.
requirements.required_harness: queue file always current on the pushed branch; ANSWERED stamps same-step; satisfied entries collapse to Closed one-liners
requirements.required_evidence: document history on the pushed branch; absence of stale satisfied entries
